purpose: 独立程序化岛屿研究室木桥构件；未进入主游戏

image.prompt: Create one single-object 3D modeling concept for a Jiangnan miniature farm game. Input 1 and input 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: rounded solid forms, restrained gongbi fine tea-brown structural brush lines, muted pale colour washes and matte natural material. Object: exactly ONE upright short stout ancient Chinese rural timber footbridge handrail post, roughly 0.9 metre tall and 0.18 metre wide, continuous square-section weathered elm timber, rounded worn corners, simple square beveled cap at top (not ornate, no pagoda ornament), a clear rectangular mortise socket on its near side 15 centimetres below the cap for a horizontal handrail, subtle visible wooden joinery peg, a small thick hemp-rope binding just below that socket with distinct rope strands. Flat wood bottom, no stone footing, no ground or base. The post is straight, substantial and functional. Warm desaturated grey umber and aged honey wood, visible long hand-painted woodgrain lines and a few broad knots, selective strong drawn edge lines that remain legible as a small 3D game prop, NO photoreal scratches, NO green tint, NO smooth toy plastic. Three-quarter view showing front, side and top, soft neutral illumination, plain cool grey background, no cast shadow except tiny contact, centered entire post with generous margins, no other posts, no rails, no text, no dimension labels, no landscape. This is an isolated component to repeat along a bridge. Save the image and return its local file path.
image.decision: 主体完整、哑光木纹、方柱榫孔与绳结清楚，采用。

tripo.reason: P2保留柱帽、榫孔及绳结的实体轮廓；v3.5 detailed保留参考图木纹，原图纹理对齐，不去除绘画明暗。

order: 保留参考图及 Tripo 原模
将木柱等比缩放到0.9米高，XZ居中、底面为零，材质粗糙度0.91
